point: AIRS 从一个预定义的内在奖励集合里,基于实时估计的任务回报自动挑选当前最合适的塑形函数,既给探索激励又缓解被内在奖励偏置的目标问题。
quote_en: AIRS selects shaping function from a predefined set based on the estimated task return in real-time, providing reliable exploration incentives and alleviating the biased objective problem.

point: 作者把内在奖励选择形式化成多臂老虎机问题,每个内在奖励函数当作一个臂。
quote_en: we formulate the intrinsic reward selection as a multi-armed bandit problem, in which different intrinsic reward functions are regarded as arms

point: AIRS 用上置信界(UCB)在估计的任务回报上做决策,选哪个内在奖励。
quote_en: AIRS formulates the intrinsic reward selection as a multi-armed bandit problem and uses the upper confidence bound (UCB) to make decisions based on the estimated task return.

point: 作者开发了一个基于 PyTorch 的内在奖励工具箱,提供多种内在奖励模块的即插即用实现。
quote_en: we develop a toolkit that provides high-quality implementations of various intrinsic reward modules based on PyTorch

point: 引入内在奖励后总目标重定义为带衰减权重 β_t 的混合回报,β_t=β_0(1-κ)^t 控制探索程度,κ 是衰减率。
quote_en: where β_t = β_0(1 − κ)^t is a weighting coefficient that controls the degree of exploration, and κ is a decay rate

point: UCB 选择规则:挑使 Q_t(I)+c·sqrt(log t / N_t(I)) 最大的内在奖励 I;c>0 控制探索程度,N_t(I) 是该臂此前被选次数。
quote_en: N_t(I) is the number of times that action I has been selected prior to time t, and c > 0 is a constant that controls the degree of exploration

point: 在价值网络里用两个分支(DAAC)分别估计混合奖励 E+I 和纯外在奖励 E 的状态价值函数,后者的平均回报用来算 Q_t。
quote_en: we employ two branches (Figure 2a) in the value network to estimate the state-value function evaluated by the mixed reward function E + I and extrinsic reward function E, respectively

point: Q_t(I) 用一个长度 W 的队列(滑动窗口)里平均估计回报的均值来算,V̄^E_φ 是一次 rollout 的平均估计回报。
quote_en: where ¯V^E_φ is the average estimated return of a rollout

point: MiniGrid 上 AIRS 建在 A2C+RE3 之上,内在奖励池只有 ID(不塑形)和 RE3 两个。
quote_en: we build it on top of A2C+RE3, in which the intrinsic reward function pool only has ID and RE3

point: Procgen 上 AIRS 建在 DAAC 之上,候选内在奖励集合是 RE3、RISE、RIDE、ID 四个函数。
quote_en: four intrinsic reward functions were selected to serve as the candidates, namely RE3, RISE, RIDE, and ID

point: MiniGrid 三个任务上 A2C+RE3 全面超过原始 A2C,而 A2C+AIRS 取得最高性能和收敛速度。
quote_en: A2C+AIRS achieves the highest performance and convergence rate in all three games

point: Procgen 上 AIRS 在四个指标上都取得最高性能,尤其是 Median 和 IQM。
quote_en: AIRS achieved the highest performance in all four metrics, especially for the Median and IQM

point: AIRS 比 DAAC 更好的概率为 67%,比 IDAAC 更好的概率为 61%。
quote_en: the probability of AIRS being better than DAAC is 67%, and the probability of AIRS being better than IDAAC is 61%

point: 训练集上 AIRS 在 16 个游戏里 8 个取得最高分,尤其是 StarPilot。
quote_en: AIRS achieves the highest performance in 8 out of 16 games, especially in the StarPilot game

point: 测试集上 AIRS 在 16 个游戏里 9 个取得最高分,尤其是 BigFish 和 StarPilot。
quote_en: AIRS achieves the highest performance in 9 out of 16 games, especially in the BigFish game and StarPilot game

point: AIRS 的决策因游戏而异:BigFish 中 RIDE 被选最多但 AIRS 有 33.7% 时间选不塑形;Miner 中 RISE 最多、59.3% 选不塑形;Ninja 中 RISE 最多、66.5% 选不塑形。
quote_en: In BigFish game, the RIDE was the most selected function while AIRS chose no shaping in 33.7% of the training time. In Miner game, the RISE was the most selected function while AIRS chose no shaping in 59.3% of the training time.

point: 消融:把内在奖励池只留 RE3 和 ID 两个模块,测试 IQM 和 OG 为 1.27 和 0.015,优于 DAAC+RE3。
quote_en: the intrinsic reward pool to have only two modules: RE3 and ID. As a result, the test IQM and OG are 1.27 and 0.015, which was better than DAAC+RE3

point: DeepMind Control Suite 四个任务(都加了干扰背景)上 AIRS 全部取得最高性能,IDAAC 在全部任务超过原始 PPO。
quote_en: AIRS achieved the highest performance in all the tasks, while IDAAC outperformed the vanilla PPO agent in all the tasks

point: Procgen 全在 25M 帧、easy 模式训练,200 个固定关卡训练、在完整关卡分布上测试;最佳超参 β_0=0.05、κ=0.000025、c=0.1、W=10。
quote_en: the best values are β_0 = 0.05, κ = 0.000025, c = 0.1, and W = 10

point: 作者自述局限:AIRS 基于预定义奖励集做选择,所选模块的质量不可避免地影响最终策略性能。
quote_en: AIRS performs selection based on a pre-defined reward set. The quality of selected reward modules will inevitably affect the final policy performance

point: 作者自述局限:不同内在奖励空间可能相互干扰,导致意外的学习崩溃。
quote_en: different intrinsic reward spaces may interfere with each other, resulting in unexpected learning collapse

point: 作者自述局限:把奖励选择当老虎机用 UCB 解,需要足够多的尝试来估计置信界,这会显著增加计算开销并降低收敛速度。
quote_en: enough attempts are required to estimate the bound. This will significantly increase the computational overhead and decrease the convergence rate

point: AIRS 在早期阶段收敛速度较低,主要受价值网络估计精度限制。
quote_en: AIRS had a lower convergence rate in the early stage, which was mainly limited by the estimation accuracy of the value network
